title: Improving Theme Park Guest Experience with Data Analytics
summary: A data science project analyzing and predicting theme park guest journeys and experience for Universal Studios Singapore, using machine learning on survey and operational data. To augment a small survey dataset, it fits SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer on real survey data to generate additional synthetic rows for downstream modeling.
evidence: src/subgroup_b/data preparation/data_preparation_qn1_5.py:115-120 uses GaussianCopulaSynthesizer to fit/sample synthetic survey data
